newsitem.title: USA: Time Warner has no comment on Havas stake.
newsitem.headline: Time Warner has no comment on Havas stake.

text.p: Time Warner Inc said Monday it had no comment on a French newspaper report that it might become a shareholder of the French media group Havas.
Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier said in an interview with La Tribune daily that Havas would like an Anglo-Saxon investor as a way to bolster its presence on the other side of the Atlantic.
"There are a number of possibilities, such as the British group Pearson or Time Warner, but I must stress that there is no mandate in this sense," said Dauzier.
Dauzier added that he was giving himself two years to secure an Anglo-Saxon investor, which would have to be compatible with Havas' key shareholder Generale des Eaux.
A Time Warner spokesman said the company had no comment. He did not elaborate further.
